name: Quran Verse Inserter
author: Shams Hasan

sections.description:
Enhance your WordPress content with beautiful Quran verses, translations, and audio recitations using this easy Gutenberg block. Powered by the reliable alquran.cloud API, this plugin allows you to insert any verse with 100+ available translations and authentic audio recitations.

This plugin is perfect for Islamic content, Muslim blogs, Quranic studies, and enriching educational materials, it uses the authentic Quran Uthmani Text from the Quran Academy. Quickly add single verses with translations and recitations to your blog posts or pages, engaging your audience and deepening their connection with the Quran. A must-have plugin for any WordPress site focused on Islamic teachings and resources.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/qvi-quran-verse-inserter directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin ‘Quran Verse Inserter’ through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Why this plugin?

This plugin provides a convenient way to insert Quranic verses into your WordPress posts or pages.

Verses not showing on block, What to do?

If you don’t see any verse loaded on the block then try to reload the page and try again.

screenshots.caption: Navigate to Posts > Add New in your WordPress dashboard and select the Quran Verse Inserter block from the Text category.
In the right sidebar, choose the surah, verse, and translation, then click Get Verse. If the sidebar isn't visible, click the settings icon in the upper right.
Fetch and display the verse in different languages seamlessly.
